body:
All experiences I`ve read about administration routes used with ketamine have a common pattern: none of them have been that simple, i.e., k turned into powder, IM and IV injecting, oral, etc., but no one considered liquid k intranasally. That`s why I decided to do it this way. It seemed easier, fast; not so much paraphernalia.
I guessed it`d be just like administered in the powder form, and it indeed was like that. I did it with a syringe, obviously. Once, the liquid is got into it, I took off the needle, got my head inclined while stopping the breathing once I`ve exhaled. Then I drink liquid for the bitter tasting liquid gets down the nose conduct. The onset took place within 3-4 mins.
